name: Greek Salad Bowl with Tzatziki & Baked Veggie Ground Meatballs
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place in a medium bowl.
Peel and mince shallots and garlic; add both to the bowl with the parsley.
Add veggie ground, eggs, almond flour, and spices to the bowl and mix with your hands until well combined.

Coat a large baking dish with a thin layer of oil. Using a tablespoon measure, form the mixture into rounded meatballs and arrange in the dish. Place dish in the oven and bake until cooked through, about 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, mince half of the cucumber and place in a small bowl along with yogurt and salt. (Reserve remaining cucumber for later use.)
Zest and juice lemon into the bowl with the cucumber and yogurt.
Shave the dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl and stir to combine the tzatziki.
Halve the remaining cucumber lengthwise, then slice crosswise into half-moons. Halve tomatoes. Place both in another medium bowl.
Trim, seed, and thinly slice bell peppers into rounds. Peel and slice additional shallots into thin rings. Add both to the bowl with the cucumber and tomato.
Add feta, olives, oil, and oregano to the bowl and stir to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad between bowls; top with veggie meatballs and tzatziki sauce. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
